name: cmdlook
description: Watch a directory and run commands when files change.

scripts.is-git-clean: (git diff --quiet --exit-code --cached && git diff --quiet --exit-code) || (echo Please commit or stash changes && exit 1)
scripts.postrelease: npm publish && git push && git push --tags && echo "Successfully released version $npm_package_version" && (open https://github.com/mathiasrw/cmdlook/releases || 1)
